product_decisions.supersession: INV-PWR-INPUT-TOPOLOGY and INV-PWR-LEGACY-250W are superseded by INV-PWR-PRODUCT-300W where they constrain capacity

invariants.statement: Rev A shall support a V100/SXM2 endpoint at 300 W sustained.
invariants.verification: Power envelope, path drop/current/thermal, transient and integrated validation.
invariants.contradiction: (300+22.7)/(12*0.90)=29.87963 A; current two-branch screen is 16 A before derating.
invariants.disposition: Foundational; current topology cannot remain a product-capacity constraint.

invariants.statement: Retain 330 W as Rev A design peak allowance unless authoritative evidence requires different/higher.
invariants.verification: Signed envelope and load-step/transient acceptance table.
invariants.contradiction: (330+22.7)/(12*0.90)=32.65741 A; no module peak waveform is retained and current entry is 16 A screen.
invariants.disposition: Retain as governing design target; no hardware pass claimed.

invariants.statement: Use a regulated current-limited 12 V cold-plug source; tolerance/current limit/source impedance remain to be bound.
invariants.verification: Power Authority input/source/harness/derating table.
invariants.contradiction: Complete source tolerance, current limit, impedance and installation are absent.

invariants.statement: Selected standard Molex 5556 two-circuit 16/18 AWG assembly is limited to 8 A/circuit at its 30 C temperature-rise table before derating; current sharing is not qualified.
invariants.verification: Exact assembly qualification and derating calculation.
invariants.current_status: PASS component limit; FAIL system capacity
invariants.contradiction: 16 A pre-derating is below 29.87963 A continuous and 32.65741 A peak.

invariants.statement: Current J5/J6 topology is two branches, each one 12 V contact plus one return.
invariants.verification: Native schematic/PCB topology census and new Power Authority design.

invariants.statement: No passive current sharing may be assumed; branches require independent current, fault and imbalance limits.
invariants.verification: Resistance/impedance model, fuse I2t/SOA and branch fault evidence.

invariants.statement: Protected source, copper, vias, return, connectors and harness shall carry 29.87963 A continuous at declared margins.
invariants.verification: Resistance/drop extraction or measurement; current density and temperature-rise analysis.
invariants.contradiction: Current census: 12V_IN_B/FUSED_12V_B zero segments/vias; 12V_PROTECTED six segments/one via; no path resistance or thermal closure.

invariants.statement: Input/protection/distribution shall survive 32.65741 A peak without unsafe collapse or protection violation.
invariants.verification: Declared waveform, source impedance, I2t/SOA and PDN/load-step analysis.
invariants.contradiction: No peak waveform or qualified assembly; connector screen is 16 A.

invariants.statement: Reverse blocking, OV/UV, surge, inrush, fuse and thermal protection shall be sized to declared envelope; component ratings do not alone qualify system.
invariants.verification: E=integral(VI dt), source impedance, fuse I2t, MOSFET SOA, clamp and thermal margins.

invariants.statement: CM5 rail is 5.0 V, 3 A design load, TPSM63606 6 A capability and 30 uF minimum effective COUT.
invariants.verification: Native net audit, vendor overlay, effective C, load-step and thermal validation.
invariants.contradiction: 50% nominal utilization is not route/transient/thermal closure.

invariants.statement: Bridge rail is 3.3 V, 2 A load, 6 A capability and 50 uF minimum effective COUT.
invariants.verification: Native continuity, vendor overlay, effective C, thermal/transient validation.
invariants.contradiction: Current census reports zero BRIDGE_3V3 segments/vias.

invariants.statement: Bridge rail is 1.1 V, 1 A load, 6 A capability and conservative 300 uF effective COUT screen.
invariants.verification: Exact capacitor DC-bias/tolerance/temp, vendor overlay, route/thermal/transient validation.
invariants.contradiction: 16*22uF*0.90*0.80=253.44uF, 46.56uF below 300uF; current census reports zero rail segments/vias.

invariants.statement: EN/UVLO, PG, reset/inhibit and branch-fault behavior shall prevent invalid operation during cold plug, brownout, overcurrent and protection faults.
invariants.verification: Schematic state table, timing analysis, ERC and permitted bring-up test.

invariants.statement: Carrier shall define and meet load-step requirements spanning 300 W sustained and 330 W peak.
invariants.verification: Signed waveform/acceptance table and labeled calculation/simulation/measurement.
invariants.contradiction: No V100/SXM2 amplitude/slew, harness/package inductance, PDN impedance or control-loop evidence.

invariants.statement: Connector/harness and power components shall remain within declared temperature limits; Molex 30 C rise is a limit, not a measurement.
invariants.verification: Loss/rise model with ambient/airflow/derating and permitted thermal validation.

invariants.statement: High-current return/reference planes shall provide documented continuity and impedance sufficient for drop, droop and ground-bounce limits.
invariants.verification: Stackup-aware extraction/simulation or approved measurement plus continuity validation.
invariants.contradiction: Census has 325 pads/47 segments/17 vias/3 zones but no impedance or bounce evidence.

invariants.statement: Raw 12 V shall not reach M.2/storage or low-voltage rails.
invariants.verification: Native netlist/pad audit plus physical copper/DRC.
invariants.current_status: PASS bounded schematic ownership; UNPROVEN physical

invariants.statement: 90% conversion efficiency is a calculation screen only until exact operating-point efficiency is established.
invariants.verification: Exact converter data/model and sensitivity with margin.

invariants.statement: Historical 250 W V100 allowance and 25.25 A total are implementation-era evidence only.
invariants.verification: Queue prerequisite audit and replacement with current IDs.

invariants.statement: Historical 28.5/34.3 A values remain provenance only until reconciled to current product and exact input architecture.
invariants.verification: Power Authority republishes one versioned envelope.

high_impact_findings.reason: Current two-branch 8 A screen cannot carry continuous envelope.
Current entry cannot carry retained peak screen; transient contract absent.
Branch-B physical path absent and protected path not capacity-qualified.
Conservative COUT screen misses by 46.56 uF and physical rail is absent.
Component ratings do not close system energy/thermal protection.
Peak waveform, PDN and load-step acceptance are missing.

evidence_gaps: qualified mating harness assembly and derating
board copper/return impedance and temperature rise
exact capacitor effective C and regulator thermal overlay
